content.title: Schwab and Robinhood Will  Match U.S. Government’s $1,000 Gift to Trump Accounts
content.summary: Charles Schwab  announced on Tuesday that it would match the federal government’s $1,000 contribution to Trump accounts for its employees with eligible newborn children.  The brokerage firm follows  Robinhood Market  s, which announced Dec. 19 on X that it would match the $1,000 federal contributions for its eligible employees.  Trump accounts are a tax-deferred savings program for children 18 and under created through tax and spending legislation this past summer.
